title: SEA LIFE Aquarium Grapevine Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Sea Life Aquarium Dallas
Admission to Legoland Discovery Center Dallas (if option selected)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Combo Ticket Child Policy: To promote a family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter LEGOLAND Discovery Center without being accompanied by a child
SEA LIFE Grapevine is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums and meets all standards including animal care and welfare, veterinary programs, conservation, education and safety.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Dive into SEA LIFE Grapevine, home to Texas’ only 360-degree Ocean Tunnel where you can come face-to-fin with sharks and rescued sea turtles. Explore over 10 stunning exhibits, including the immersive Seahorse Temple and the vibrant Mangrove Forest filled with freshwater fish and turtles. Experience 260,000 gallons of underwater wonders perfect for family fun and marine life education.
